jds.title: Supply Chain Analyst
jds.description: Fresher Supply Chain Analyst for demand planning and inventory. Work on forecasts, OTIF dashboards, and vendor coordination. Excel, SQL, Forecasting, Inventory planning required; operations internship preferred. Portfolio or internships preferred. Preferred certifications: APICS CSCP fundamentals (awareness), Six Sigma Yellow Belt.
